claims.text: Partners in the 60 days before Sx onset: evaluate, test and presumptively treat for chlamydia + gonorrhea
claims.quote: Persons who have had sexual contact with a partner with PID during the 60 days preceding symptom onset should be evaluated, tested, and presumptively treated for chlamydia and gonorrhea, regardless of the PID etiology or pathogens isolated.
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2021;70(4):1-187 (PMC8344968)
